what: P2b-1 acceptance (plan v4 'Vorher/Nachher-Lauf') on the VM sim: one real page (headless Chromium, llvmpipe, 6 cores), the simulation on, load -> run with M600 -> tool change (M61 Q99 G43) -> load
limits: the before tree has no per-instance word: its builds are the tap's rule (a request with the bodies builds one model per shard it runs on, collisionWorker.shardCount's formula with the page's cores and the request's triangles)
the late windows are counted per page over the whole window, not joined to the build phases; on the VM the page renders with llvmpipe
the machine measurement follows at the next visit (plan v4)

row.detail: one build per instance and model generation

p2b2_acceptance.rule: plan v4 P2b-2 'Abnahme': on the same load sequence no check cancelled by a drift parse that was already decided at its start; cancels by later input changes allowed and counted
p2b2_acceptance.clock: the browser's own t_wall_ms for its events (the gateway stamps their receipt, batched every 2 s)

before.the_cancel: check 2 started 0.91 s after the load's publication, cancelled 3.2 s later by the toolsetter read-back's parse (job 2)

after.the_cancel: check 2 started 27.42 s, BEFORE the read-back's synch ended (28.58 s); that parse was decided at 30.61 s (2.03 s after the action's observed end) and published at 30.69 s - a later decision, allowed
